plain_english: And of this proved pradhāna there is, by anvaya and the rest — by denial of self-aims and the like, person-aim-ness is proved.
sanskrit_cite: asti cāsya pradhānasya prasiddhasyānvayādinā svārthatādiniṣedhena sādhitā puruṣārthatā

plain_english: Through that, person's enjoyment-proving again and again — so change would be nothing hard.
sanskrit_cite: tenāsya bhogasaṃsiddhiḥ puruṣasya yathā yathā tathā tathā pariṇatiḥ syānna kiṃcana durghaṭam

plain_english: Hence indeed, for ever-becoming pradhāna, no efficient cause but person-aim-striving.
sanskrit_cite: ata eva pradhānasya mahattvapariṇāminaḥ nimittakāraṇaṃ nānyatpuruṣārthodyamādṛte

plain_english: Own-nature indeed — and this of this — from seeing the root-cause on; below mind-ground, toward body-ordaining.
sanskrit_cite: svabhāva eva caiṣo'sya mūlahetostathekṣaṇāt cittabhūmeradharataḥ śarīrādividhiṃ prati

plain_english: As efficient cause, karma could be original-natured even. Then here — where is Īśvara's business to be conceived?
sanskrit_cite: nimittakāraṇaṃ karma syādapyādyasvabhāvataḥ tato'tra kutra vyāpāra īśvarasyopakalpyatām

plain_english: Protecting the inner-organ-rangers in root-nature, of secret nature — let Īśvara's change-causality be conceived.
If of uniform-change-nature — then thence: independent seed-kitchen, as in sprouts.
sanskrit_cite: yadyathā pariṇāmaikasvabhāvaṃ tatra tattataḥ ananyāpekṣi bījādisāmagrī yadvadaṅkure

plain_english: The mahad-first-change-torrent-natured, three-natured pradhāna-self — thereby godless Sāṅkhya.
sanskrit_cite: mahadādivikāraughapariṇāmasvabhāvakam triguṇātma pradhānaṃ ca tena sāṃkhyamanīśvaram

plain_english: If puruṣārtha-natured in all function-acts — by pradhāna it is conceived as efficient.
